<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // === Mobile Menu ===
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
  var mobileNav = document.querySelector('.mobile-nav');
  var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // === Donation Modal ===
  var modal = document.getElementById('donate-modal');
  var modalClose = modal.querySelector('.modal-close');
  var donateTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.donate-trigger');
  var amountBtns = modal.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn');
  var customInput = modal.querySelector('#custom-amount-input');
  var lastFocusedElement = null;

  function openModal() {
    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
    modal.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    modalClose.focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (lastFocusedElement) lastFocusedElement.focus();
  }

  donateTriggers.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  });

  modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
  });

  amountBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
      btn.classList.add('selected');
      customInput.value = '';
    });
  });

  customInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (customInput.value) {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
    }
  });

  // === Accordion ===
  var accordionTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-trigger');

  accordionTriggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      var panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-panel');
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item.active').forEach(function(openItem) {
        openItem.classList.remove('active');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-panel').style.maxHeight = null;
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        item.classList.add('active');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });

  // === News Carousel ===
  var track = document.querySelector('.news-track');
  var prevBtn = document.querySelector('.news-prev');
  var nextBtn = document.querySelector('.news-next');
  var carouselIndex = 0;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 600) return 1;
    if (w <= 900) return 2;
    return 3;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var card = track.querySelector('.news-card');
    if (!card) return 0;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(track);
    var gap = parseFloat(style.gap) || 24;
    return card.offsetWidth + gap;
  }

  function updateCarousel() {
    var totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    var visible = getVisibleCount();
    var maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - visible);
    if (carouselIndex > maxIndex) carouselIndex = maxIndex;

    var offset = carouselIndex * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';

    prevBtn.disabled = carouselIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = carouselIndex >= maxIndex;
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (carouselIndex > 0) { carouselIndex--; updateCarousel(); }
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    var visible = getVisibleCount();
    if (carouselIndex < totalCards - visible) { carouselIndex++; updateCarousel(); }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { updateCarousel(); });
  updateCarousel();

  // === Impact Counter Animation ===
  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  var counterAnimated = false;

  function formatNumber(n, prefix, suffix) {
    if (n >= 1000000) return prefix + (n / 1000000).toFixed(0) + 'M';
    if (n >= 1000) return prefix + n.toLocaleString() + (suffix && suffix !== 'M' ? suffix : '');
    return prefix + n + suffix;
  }

  function animateCounters() {
    if (counterAnimated) return;
    counterAnimated = true;

    counters.forEach(function(counter) {
      var target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-target'), 10);
      var prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
      var suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
      var duration = 2000;
      var start = 0;
      var startTime = null;

      function step(timestamp) {
        if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
        var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
        var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        var current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        counter.textContent = formatNumber(current, prefix, suffix);
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          counter.textContent = formatNumber(target, prefix, suffix);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }

  var reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  if (reducedMotion) {
    counterAnimated = true;
  } else {
    var impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });
    observer.observe(impactSection);
  }

})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // === Mobile Menu ===
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
  var mobileNav = document.querySelector('.mobile-nav');
  var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // === Donation Modal ===
  var modal = document.getElementById('donate-modal');
  var modalClose = modal.querySelector('.modal-close');
  var donateTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.donate-trigger');
  var amountBtns = modal.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn');
  var customInput = modal.querySelector('#custom-amount-input');
  var lastFocusedElement = null;

  function openModal() {
    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
    modal.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    modalClose.focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (lastFocusedElement) lastFocusedElement.focus();
  }

  donateTriggers.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  });

  modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
  });

  amountBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
      btn.classList.add('selected');
      customInput.value = '';
    });
  });

  customInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (customInput.value) {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
    }
  });

  // === Accordion ===
  var accordionTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-trigger');

  accordionTriggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      var panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-panel');
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item.active').forEach(function(openItem) {
        openItem.classList.remove('active');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-panel').style.maxHeight = null;
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        item.classList.add('active');

  });

  }

      background: var(--white); border-radius: 16px; max-width: 520px; width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; position: relative;
      animation: modalIn 300ms ease;
    }
    @keyframes modalIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .modal-header {
      padding: 28px 28px 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .modal-header h2 { font-size: 24px; color: var(--gray-900); }
    .modal-close {
      width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer; background: var(--gray-100); transition: background var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0; border: none;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gray-200); }
    .modal-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .modal-close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: var(--gray-600); fill: none; stroke-width: 2; }
    .modal-body { padding: 24px 28px 28px; }
    .modal-body p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 24px; line-height: 1.6; }

    .amount-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .amount-btn {
      padding: 16px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: var(--white); cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), background var(--transition);
      min-height: 48px;
    }
    .amount-btn:hover { border-color: var(--red); }
    .amount-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .amount-btn.selected { border-color: var(--red); background: rgba(196,30,58,0.05); }
    .amount-btn .amount-value {
      font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gray-900);
      display: block;
    }
    .amount-btn .amount-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); margin-top: 4px; display: block; }

    .custom-amount {
      display: flex; align-items: center; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }
    .custom-amount:focus-within { border-color: var(--navy); }
    .custom-amount span { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-400); }
    .custom-amount input {
      border: none; outline: none; flex: 1; padding: 14px 8px; font-size: 18px;
      font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .modal .btn-primary { width: 100%; font-size: 18px; padding: 16px; }
    .modal-impact {
      text-align: center; margin-top: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-500);
    }
    .modal-impact svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: var(--gray-400); fill: none; stroke-width: 2; display: inline-block; vertical-align: -2px; margin-right: 4px; }

    /* ====== SKIP LINK ====== */
    .skip-link {
      position: absolute; top: -100%; left: 16px; background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
      padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; z-index: 9999; font-weight: 600;
    }
    .skip-link:focus { top: 16px; }

    /* ====== REDUCED MOTION ====== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

    /* News image placeholders */
    .news-img-placeholder {
      width: 100%; height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px; color: var(--gray-500); font-weight: 500;

    .news-img-placeholder.img-hurricane { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1B3A5C 0%, #2A5580 100%); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .news-img-placeholder.img-wildfire { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C41E3A 0%, #E8354F 100%); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .news-img-placeholder.img-blood { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7C3AED 0%, #A78BFA 100%); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .news-img-placeholder.img-volunteer { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #059669 0%, #34D399 100%); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
  </style>
</head>

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // === Mobile Menu ===
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
  var mobileNav = document.querySelector('.mobile-nav');
  var mobileLinks = mobileNav.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  mobileLinks.forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // === Donation Modal ===
  var modal = document.getElementById('donate-modal');
  var modalClose = modal.querySelector('.modal-close');
  var donateTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.donate-trigger');
  var amountBtns = modal.querySelectorAll('.amount-btn');
  var customInput = modal.querySelector('#custom-amount-input');
  var lastFocusedElement = null;

  function openModal() {
    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
    modal.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    modalClose.focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (lastFocusedElement) lastFocusedElement.focus();
  }

  donateTriggers.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', openModal);
  });

  modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
  });

  amountBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
      btn.classList.add('selected');
      customInput.value = '';
    });
  });

  customInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    if (customInput.value) {
      amountBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
    }
  });

  // === Accordion ===
  var accordionTriggers = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-trigger');

  accordionTriggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      var panel = item.querySelector('.accordion-panel');
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('active');

      // Close all
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item.active').forEach(function(openItem) {
        openItem.classList.remove('active');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        openItem.querySelector('.accordion-panel').style.maxHeight = null;
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        item.classList.add('active');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });

  // === News Carousel ===
  var track = document.querySelector('.news-track');
  var prevBtn = document.querySelector('.news-prev');
  var nextBtn = document.querySelector('.news-next');
  var carouselIndex = 0;

  function getVisibleCount() {
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w <= 600) return 1;
    if (w <= 900) return 2;
    return 3;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var card = track.querySelector('.news-card');
    if (!card) return 0;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(track);
    var gap = parseFloat(style.gap) || 24;
    return card.offsetWidth + gap;
  }

  function updateCarousel() {
    var totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    var visible = getVisibleCount();
    var maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - visible);
    if (carouselIndex > maxIndex) carouselIndex = maxIndex;

    var offset = carouselIndex * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';

    prevBtn.disabled = carouselIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = carouselIndex >= maxIndex;
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (carouselIndex > 0) { carouselIndex--; updateCarousel(); }
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var totalCards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    var visible = getVisibleCount();
    if (carouselIndex < totalCards - visible) { carouselIndex++; updateCarousel(); }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { updateCarousel(); });
  updateCarousel();

  // === Impact Counter Animation ===
  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.impact-number');
  var counterAnimated = false;

  function formatNumber(n, prefix, suffix) {
    if (n >= 1000000) return prefix + (n / 1000000).toFixed(0) + 'M';
    if (n >= 1000) return prefix + n.toLocaleString() + (suffix && suffix !== 'M' ? suffix : '');
    return prefix + n + suffix;
  }

  function animateCounters() {
    if (counterAnimated) return;
    counterAnimated = true;

    counters.forEach(function(counter) {
      var target = parseInt(counter.getAttribute('data-target'), 10);
      var prefix = counter.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
      var suffix = counter.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
      var duration = 2000;
      var start = 0;
      var startTime = null;

      function step(timestamp) {
        if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
        var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
        var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        var current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        counter.textContent = formatNumber(current, prefix, suffix);
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          counter.textContent = formatNumber(target, prefix, suffix);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }

  var reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  if (reducedMotion) {
    counterAnimated = true;
  } else {
    var impactSection = document.getElementById('impact');
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });
    observer.observe(impactSection);
  }

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

The Global Aid Alliance site is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Sections (all 9 from spec):** Header with utility bar, Hero with dual CTAs, Mission statement, Impact stats (animated counters), Programs accordion, Get Involved cards, News carousel, Donate CTA, Footer with full navigation.

**Key interactions:**
- **Donation modal** — triggered by all "Donate" buttons, with 6 preset amounts ($25–$1,000) showing impact descriptions, custom amount input, and keyboard/escape close
- **Animated counters** — IntersectionObserver triggers count-up animation (12M, 50K, 190, $850M) with eased timing when the impact section scrolls into view
- **News carousel** — functional prev/next buttons, responsive (3→2→1 cards), smooth slide transition
- **Program accordion** — expand/collapse with chevron rotation, one-at-a-time behavior
- **Mobile hamburger menu** — animated three-line-to-X toggle, full-screen overlay, links auto-close menu

**Design system:** Brand colors (#C41E3A red, #1B3A5C navy, white), Poppins/Open Sans typography, 38 ARIA attributes, focus-visible states, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, responsive breakpoints at 480/600/768/900px.
